description: Build a formula that ranks one column, with a choice of tie handling (min: 1,2,2,4; dense: 1,2,2,3; avg: 1,2.5,2.5,4; unique: 1,2,3,4) and optional ranking within a group column. mode "column" fills the whole column from one cell; mode "row" is a per-row formula to drag down.

group.description: Optional column letter; ranks restart in each group

range.description: One column with its first row, header left out: B2:B, B2:B200 or Data!B2:B

separator.description: Argument separator: "," (US/UK locale) or ";" (many European locales)

name: sheets_rank_formula
title: Google Sheets RANK formula
